weapons.name: AWM Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Accuracy International, "AWM in .338 Lapua Magnum": "Barrels in caliber .300 Win Mag AWM are 660mm (26\") long and the length of the .338 Lap Mag is 686mm (27\"), both using 1 in 11 twist barrels." States the .338 Lapua Magnum AWM barrel uses a 1 turn in 11 inch twist = 279.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: AR-10B Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: ArmaLite AR-10B model data: "BARREL: 20\" CHROME LINED" and "RIFLING TWIST: RH 1:11.25 INCH". States a right-hand 1 turn in 11.25 inch twist = 285.75 mm per turn.

weapons.name: AR-10 Super SASS Semi-auto Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: ArmaLite AR-10 SuperSASS model data: "BARREL: 24\" SST T HEAVY" and "RIFLING TWIST: 1:11.25 INCH". States a 1 turn in 11.25 inch twist = 285.75 mm per turn for the original AR-10 SuperSASS.

weapons.name: AR-180B Semi-auto Rifle
weapons.source_note: ArmaLite AR-180B model data: "BARREL: 19.8 CHROME MOLY, RH 1:9 INCH TWIST, NATO CHAMBER". States a right-hand 1 turn in 9 inch twist = 228.6 mm per turn.

weapons.name: Thompson M1A1 Submachine Gun
weapons.source_note: Dockery Armory reference entry for the M1A1 Thompson: "RIFLING (TYPE & TWIST) – 6 Groove, Right hand twist, one turn in 41 cm (16 in)". States a six-groove right-hand 1 turn in 16 inch twist = 406.4 mm per turn.

weapons.name: MRAD Sniper Rifle
weapons.source_note: Barrett MRAD specifications for the .338 Lapua Magnum configuration: "Twist Rate 1 : 9.4\" (240 mm)". Barrett states the twist directly in millimetres as 240 mm per turn.
